decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

(Reason.  In order to safeguard the visual amenity of the area and building in particular and to satisfy the requirements of policies ENV B1.1New Development and H6.4 Extensions and alterations)

Condition : 3 - The proposed roof extension, by reason of its size, design and appearance would be in keeping with the character and appearance of the streetscene and would not harm the living conditions of the neighbouring properties, in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of roof extension to flat.
